<action type="say">
My attempt to block your card just failed due to an internal error on the bank’s side, and the card has NOT been blocked yet. We need to use a different channel immediately.

Do this right now (in order of speed):

1) Call the bank’s emergency card line  
- Use the number on the back of any other card from this bank, or on your statement/website/app (usually listed as “Lost or Stolen Cards” or “24/7 Fraud”).  
- Tell them: “My main credit card ending in 7890 (Travel Card) was stolen and your online assistant couldn’t block it. I need it blocked and reissued immediately.”

2) If you have the mobile app:  
- Look for a “Card controls,” “Lock card,” or “Freeze card” option under your Travel Card. If you see it, lock/freeze the card right away, then still call to report it stolen and request a replacement.

3) If you can’t call:  
- Use secure messaging in online banking (if available) and mark it as urgent: “Stolen card – please block immediately and order replacement.”  
- Or visit a local branch in person as soon as possible and report it there.

After you’ve contacted them:
- Ask the agent to review the most recent transactions with you and flag any you don’t recognize.  
- For any unauthorized charges, ask them to open fraud claims on the spot.

If you tell me how you usually access your bank (mobile app, website, or only phone), I can give you click‑by‑click steps to find the correct number or card‑lock feature there.</action>
